# PlayCanvas Zstandard decoder

These files are copied from the [PlayCanvas 2.24.2 Zstandard module](https://github.com/playcanvas/engine/tree/c46a3cf735588a14b774e0f7d3e866e5cb102fb7/examples/assets/wasm/zstd). The web build bundles them for the PlayCanvas SPZ v4 parser. The upstream glue script identifies the Zstandard and zstddec components in the Wasm binary. Their licenses are included here.
